# Curated language-runtime stack-frame regexes (RE2), distilled from OffenRed-AI-DAST
# recon (stage2c_signal_patterns.py / response_signals.py). One RE2 pattern per line;
# '#' comments and blank lines ignored. FORMAT FACTS only (public conventions), not
# proprietary code. Fed to error-disclosure.yaml stackTrace[] (PS-006). Keep tight —
# each must be a runtime frame shape unlikely to occur in benign prose.
# Python traceback frame: File "<path>.py", line N
File "[^"]+\.py", line \d+
# Java stack frame: at pkg.Class.method(File.java:NN)
\bat [\w.$]+\([\w ]+\.java:\d+\)
# Node/JS V8 frame: at fn (/path/file.js:LINE:COL)
\bat [^\n]+\([^)]+\.js:\d+:\d+\)
# PHP stack frame: #N /path/file.php(NN):
#\d+ /[^\s:]+\.php\(\d+\)
# Ruby frame: path.rb:NN:in `method'
\.rb:\d+:in [`']
# Python traceback header (multi-frame marker)
Traceback \(most recent call last\)
